name: Contest of Champions
description: The Grandmaster challenges Death itself to a cosmic game, conscripting Earth's heroes as pawns. Scattered across the globe, the champions must win their contests or forfeit reality to an Elder of the Universe.
flavorText: The game is simple. The stakes are everything.
musicAIPrompt: Create a 45-second seamless loopable orchestral film score in the exact style of John Williams. Grand March / Processional. Cosmic game of the Elders with heroes as pawns. Stately ceremonial brass and harp with game-show fanfare energy. Regal and cosmic, wide stereo, instrumental only, perfectly loopable with no fade in/out.
